structured.approach: This attempt fixes the G1 refusal. FIN-OPS-2026-07 had been listed among the related items said to share a rule or code with ZD-48600. It is a configuration-only change to max_tokens and shares neither, so I removed it from the grouped list and marked it "Not grouped" in the duplicate table. Its max_tokens conflict with PROV-ACME-2026-11 is kept only as a side observation for the PM (new OQ-5), split out of OQ-3. The grouped list now names four items, each with its link stated: ZD-48501 and ZD-48211 (shared overdue rule), and ZD-48470 and PROV-ACME-2026-11 (shared code). The fixes from earlier attempts are kept: the CR-4 provider/model statement is scoped to this ticket, there is no status or oracle-field statement, and every cited file was opened with Read. The classification is unchanged: New Feature, Not Technical Only, a Technical sub-category for each CR, no duplicates merged, and the impacted repositories taken from the routing maps. I rewrote the file in full.

claims.text: FEAT-ZD-48600 is classified as New Feature. It adds four new functions (delays_by_vendor, vendor_risk, overdue_with_risk, renderOverdueRisk) and an optional paid_date feed column, and existing signatures are kept.
It is not Compliance, because no regulatory source applies to this change.
The qualifier is Not Technical Only, because the item adds a customer-visible overdue-risk table in ap_portal for AP managers. Each change request has a Technical sub-category.
ap_forecast currently uses provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2, for the payment-delay explanation. Ticket ZD-48600 itself asks for no change of provider or model.

PROV-ACME-2026-11 replaces acme-text-2 (deprecated on 2026-12-01) with acme-text-3 and adds a system field. CR-4 changes the same function (build_explanation_request), so PROV-ACME-2026-11 is grouped as related through shared code and needs ordering.
ZD-48501 and ZD-48211 are grouped as related through the shared rule (unpaid invoices more than 30 days past due) but ask for different outputs. They are not duplicates.
ZD-48470 (feed v2 adds currency) changes the same vendor feed as CR-1 (feed v3 adds paid_date). It is grouped as related through shared code, not as a duplicate.
FIN-OPS-2026-07 is a configuration-only change (max_tokens from 300 to 200, with no code or behaviour change). It shares no rule or code with ZD-48600 and is not grouped.
Outside this item, FIN-OPS-2026-07 (max_tokens 200) conflicts with PROV-ACME-2026-11 (keep max_tokens at 300).
ZD-48455 highlights rows of the portal aging table with class row-overdue. It is neither grouped nor a duplicate.
ZD-48510 asks for payment execution, which is out of scope for this item. It is not grouped.
ZD-48377, RETRO-2026-19, ZD-48480 and REG-LPR-2026-4.2 concern ap_aging buckets, error messages, README definitions and the Late rule at more than 60 days. They are not duplicates.
The risk tier is T2 with no payment execution, and the risk label is advisory only. The ticket is linked to roadmap item R-AP-12.

Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline (Data Engineering Coding Agent), ap_forecast (Data Science Agent), ap_aging (Backend Coding Agent), ap_portal (Frontend Coding Agent). End-to-end tests go to the Testing Agent.
CR-5 has to follow D-2026-044 and L-011 (Decimal amounts) and D-2026-050 (paid invoices excluded).

open_questions: OQ-1: Should ZD-48501, ZD-48211 and CR-5 share one overdue definition in ap_aging ('unpaid and more than 30 days past due')? Nothing was merged.
OQ-2: CR-1 names feed v3, and ZD-48470 brings feed v2 (currency). Must ZD-48470 be delivered first?

OQ-3: PROV-ACME-2026-11 (acme-text-2 to acme-text-3, plus a system field) and CR-4 (risk argument) both change build_explanation_request. Which order should they land in, and should the CR-4 tests run against the model current at delivery?
OQ-4: Should org/org.routing_map.md be updated with the owners of ap_pipeline, ap_forecast and ap_portal? Today they exist only in the feature override.
OQ-5 (outside this item, for the PM): PROV-ACME-2026-11 keeps max_tokens at 300, while FIN-OPS-2026-07 lowers it from 300 to 200. Which one applies?

Carried forward from feat.prebacklog: Q-1 (duplicate check against the board), Q-2 (is feed v3 a registered connector), Q-3 (notification channel), Q-4 (unpaid row with a paid_date), Q-5 (HTML escaping in renderOverdueRisk).
structured.summary: I rewrote feat.classification for FEAT-ZD-48600 in full. FIN-OPS-2026-07 is no longer grouped, because it is configuration-only and shares no rule or code with this item. Its max_tokens conflict with PROV-ACME-2026-11 is now a separate PM question (OQ-5). Four items are grouped: ZD-48501 and ZD-48211 share the overdue rule, and ZD-48470 and PROV-ACME-2026-11 change the same code. The classification is unchanged: New Feature with the qualifier Not Technical Only, a Technical sub-category for each of CR-1 to CR-7, and no duplicates merged. Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal. All open questions are non-blocking.
